prose: Artificial Analysis evaluates Claude Sonnet 5.5: at max effort it gains 18 points over Sonnet 5 and takes #2 on the Intelligence Index, behind only Opus 5.5 (max). It reaches parity with Opus 5.5 on Terminal-Bench 4.0-class agentic work (64% vs 60% for Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra), AA-Briefcase, GDPval-AA, and AutomationBench-AA - but gets there with the heaviest token usage ever measured: ~193k output tokens per task, about 60% higher than Opus 5.5 (max) and ~7x GPT-6 Astra (max). Pricing matches Sonnet 5 at $2/$10 per million input/output, yet cost per task lands near $7.60, ~50% above Sonnet 5, leaving it off the intelligence-vs-cost Pareto frontier except at high effort, where it sits narrowly behind GPT-6 Sol. It lags Opus 5.5 on factual knowledge (54% vs 66% on AA-Omniscience, though with a lower hallucination rate). Anthropic flagged a pre-release bug that can degrade results.
